title: Shark Attacks
text:
The Global Shark Attack File is a collection of reported shark encounters from around the world. Its records include details such as the location, activity, and whether an attack was fatal.
Public fear of sharks is often out of proportion to the actual risk. Fatal shark attacks are rare, and media coverage can make isolated encounters seem more common than they are.
This site explores the data in two ways. The Map page shows where attacks were reported, while the Trends page examines patterns by activity and outcome.
